newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices mostly steady.

text.p: Millfeed prices were mostly steady on Friday, underpinned by a reduction of flour supplies, dealers said.
"A fair amount of flour mills have been running poorly, at least in the East and Midwest," one Missouri dealer said.
He noted the market was focused on the lack of supply and that demand was fairly steady.
"The word is that the flour mills are not putting out much production in the Carolinas. I think it's kind of like that everywhere. So the supply is limited," a Carolinas dealer said.
"We have got a few cases of flour mills buying midds to cover some of their own sales because their run times are short," he said.
But in Minnesota, a dealer said winter demand was normal and supplies were adequate.
